sections.title: Sites written in code, content managed in a panel
sections.body: Build the page from blocks: drag, drop, edit.

items.title: Git-based
items.text: Content lives in your repository as plain files; every save is a commit.

items.title: Multilingual
items.text: One file per language, and you choose the fields to translate.

items.title: Drag and drop
items.text: Lists and blocks sort by dragging.
